name: Village Center (Rua Principal and Rua da Igreja)
description: The lively core of the village, where the main sand streets Rua Principal and Rua da Igreja concentrate restaurants, bars, pousadas, kite schools, and shops. Everything is walkable, evenings buzz with forro and caipirinhas, and you are steps from the beach and the daily flow of travelers.
bestFor: First-timers and social nomads who want everything within walking distance
pros: Walk to restaurants, bars, and services
Central and easy for meeting people
Best wifi and pousada options concentrated here
cons: Higher prices than the quieter edges

name: Beachfront toward the Sunset Dune
tagline: Sea views and sundowners on the Duna do Por do Sol
description: The stretch along the main beach leading up to the Duna do Por do Sol, where pousadas trade central bustle for sea breezes and sunset ritual. Each evening travelers climb the dune for the famous sundown, and beachfront bars and kite launch spots sit right on your doorstep.
bestFor: Kitesurfers and beach lovers who want the water and sunsets on their doorstep
cons: Exposed to wind and blowing sand

name: Quiet edges toward Pedra Furada and the lagoons
tagline: Calmer outskirts near the wild coast
description: The mellower fringes of the village stretching toward the Pedra Furada rock arch and the routes out to Lagoa do Paraiso and Lagoa Azul. Lodging is quieter and often cheaper here, trading nightlife proximity for calm, a slower pace, and easier access to buggy trips and nature.
bestFor: Slow travelers and remote workers wanting calm and cheaper monthly rates
pros: Close to nature and buggy tours
cons: Longer walk to the main nightlife

name: Prea and Jijoca (nearby bases)
tagline: Kite-central Prea and the gateway town Jijoca
description: Prea is a quieter kitesurf beach a short drive east of Jeri, prized for wide flat-water launches and a mellow scene, while Jijoca de Jericoacoara is the mainland gateway town where the jardineira transfer begins. Both suit those wanting space, wind, and lower prices away from the village core.
bestFor: Dedicated kitesurfers and budget travelers who prefer space over village buzz
pros: Excellent, uncrowded kite conditions at Prea
cons: Away from Jeri's nightlife and dining
Need transport for the village and services
